things.note: A blueprint-style node-and-line diagram stands in; no app interface or real map.
A circle with the label HOME.
A circle with the label WORK.
A circle with the label PARK.
A circle with the label CAFE.
Numbers (4, 2, 1, 5, 8) beside plain lines; the lines are all the same length-agnostic strokes, so minutes are known only by the numerals.
Thin straight lines connecting circles; no road look.
Lines Home-Park, Park-Cafe, Cafe-Work light up in yellow with a text line HOME > PARK > CAFE > WORK = 8.

changes.change: Home is set as start with distance 0 (others start at infinity)
changes.note: Infinity marks appear on the other places, Home gets 0 and a yellow ring/fill.
A yellow pulse travels along the Home-Park line and the park tag changes from infinity to 2.
A pulse travels along the Home-Cafe line and the cafe tag changes from infinity to 4.

changes.change: Cafe drops from 4 to 3 via the park
changes.note: A pulse moves along the Park-Cafe line, then the cafe tag changes 4 to 3; the shortcut line lights yellow.

changes.change: Work gets 10 via the park, then drops to 8 via the cafe
changes.note: Pulse along Park-Work gives Work 10, later a pulse along Cafe-Work changes it to 8. Number changes are partly just tags but pulses and fills show the flow.

changes.change: Each closest place is settled in turn (cafe, then work)
changes.note: Cafe circle pops and fills yellow, then Work fills yellow.
Route lines stay bright yellow while unused roads (Home-Cafe, Park-Work) fade dim; an 8 MINUTES label and the route text appear.
